items.title: Caleb Williams: Listed as questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Williams (hamstring) was a limited practice participant Friday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Green Bay.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Good to go Sunday
items.text:
Swift (hip/knee) was a full participant in Friday's practice and doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Packers.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Good to go for Week 5
items.text:
Shough (left hand) practiced fully Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Vikings, Emily Leiker of The Minnesota Star Tribune reports.
